review.title: Actual tummy control
review.content: I ordered this in green and it is a nice neutral sage shade. I love that this swimsuit not only disguises my tummy area with the side ruching but the fabric has actual tummy control. I ordered this suit in a large (size 8-10) and it fits great. The swimsuit is very flattering on with the ruching and cut. I like that the suit has good coverage in the back. It is on the modest side making it the perfect suit for wearing to the community pool or waterpark with my kids. Another huge plus of this suit is that the padding is molded and does not move around when the swimsuit is wet. Great swimsuit, I want to order it in black too!!

review.title: Fabric & Style are dreamy -- sizing is off
review.content: I absolutely adore the silky, soft, stretchy fabric of this pajama set -- they feel heavenly on your skin. They are seemingly very well-made -- the contrast piping is well-sewn and straight, and the buttons are secure. I am 6" tall and typically wear a 12-14. I bought this set in XL (also noted as a 16-18), hoping for an oversized fit that is comfy and free-flowing like the picture appears in the listing. These pajamas are actually snug on me -- not hugging my body, but certainly not fitting like an XL. I agree with another reviewer that the XL fits like a Large in American sizing. If you can size up one size for a more snatched fit, and two sizes up for an actual loose fit, then you'll love these.

product.product_name: Bamboo Footies Mitten Long-Sleeve One-Piece Double Zipper Banana

review.title: Quality and comfort, a flattering fit like exercise wear
review.content: So far, I have loved the Lulukaka brand for its comfortable quality sleepwear. This set also lives up to my expectations of quality and comfort. I was intrigued by the fabric being 95% viscose from bamboo and 5% spandex. It was promoted as being more breathable & moisture-wicking… so I was inspired to order these pajamas… Their online ad said: “Bamboo Viscose is known for its exceptional moisture-wicking properties, making them breathable, cooling pajamas for women on hot nights. Great for those who are experiencing hot flashes or night sweats, ensuring a sweat-free and peaceful sleep.” I will appreciate that on those hot nights when I wake up sweating! The comfort factor extends to the way these pajamas felt on my skin the minute I put them on, though. The fabric feels ultra soft as well as being comfortably stretchy. I ordered the floral print set, with the solid navy top and floral pants. I was pleasantly surprised by how flattering the fit was, both top and bottom… having ordered the large. I’m so happy the fit is flattering for a change, not too oversized, nor too tight. The long-sleeved top in navy can serve other purposes as well, as I’m always looking for a fitted navy tee to wear with denim, underneath denim shirts or sweaters. The floral bottoms, which I wasn't sure about, as being my style, are actually cute on! They are a nice change from all my solid-colored sleepwear. The waist has a drawstring, but for me, the elastic waist fits snug, so the drawstring is totally unnecessary. My only wish is that the waist was looser... the elastic waist is a little too snug... my waist is 35". The overall fit of the pant legs clings just a little, but with the elasticity of the fabric, it’s a flattering fit. This set actually fits like exercise wear, with movement not restricted in the least. I will probably wear them on those days when I don’t change into street clothes, just to hang around the house in. They make me feel good because they are so cute on! I recommend them... unless your waist is much larger than 35", which might make them too uncomfortable around the waist.

review.title: Order up
review.content: This bathing suit was super cute in the advertisement so I bought it. On the overall, I do like it. The suit is 3 different shades of blue with a pale blue on the top and it getting darker to navy on the bottom. While this is a one piece suit, it has cutouts which looked cute on the model in the photos but in reality I didn’t find it flattering for me as I still have some tummy that needs toning. I bought an XXL and it fit, although I am a size large in most things now. I would have preferred if the slits had a clear mesh behind them so it would still provide support and hold me in and not have my tummy popping out. I do really love the starfish details and the beads along the straps, though I do worry the metal might get hot in the sun and become uncomfortable. I found this suit fit well but I had to order 2 sizes up and while it is cute, it is not practical for someone who is a bit bigger and has “rolls”. A clear mesh underlay would have helped provide support and coverage, and would have helped this suit be more flattering, in my opinion.

product.product_name: Bamboo Long-Sleeve Baby One-Piece Sloths Print

review.title: OK, but lacking in a few features
review.content: I'm a big fan of bamboo fabric for its smoothness and cooling qualities. And since I tend to run hot while sleeping, I thought these would be perfect. Although they are fine, a few things keep me from giving them a higher rating. The fit is just OK. I won't say they aren't true to size, as they mostly are, but I was expecting them to be looser. According to the size chart, I should be on the lower end of the size range, but instead when I wear them they fit more like I'm at the top of the range. Wish the shorts had pockets. For this price, I feel like they should have. The waistband is moderately stretchy, but for pajamas, I wish the elastic were softer and stretchier. It isn't restrictive, but it isn't as comfortable as it could be. The fabric is nice and soft, and cool to the touch, and they stay cool throughout the night. However, the pink is more see-through than I'd like it to be. Not that big of a deal since they're pajamas, but as the fabric is a little clingy, it's definitely not something i would feel comfortable wearing to answer the doorbell.

product.product_name: Christmas Family Matching Pajamas | Allover Snowman Print Long Sleeve Set

review.title: Comfortable
review.content: These pajamas are luxuriously comfortable! The bamboo cotton is very soft against my skin and the beautiful lilac color is true to the advertisement picture. The stitching detail was quality - tight, with no loose threads. The stitching around the arm cuff added presentation, but made the cuff somewhat stiffer than the rest of the garment. Although it looked good and was not irritating to me, I can see where it might be to someone else, (so -1 star). I found the elastic waistband to be effective, yet not tight and constricting, which is good. Sizing was accurate, however the inseam of the shorts was quite a bit longer than I expected. I believe this design allows for a modifiable fit to various body shapes within the sizing ranges. I could actually hike the shorts all the way up to my breasts before the crotch was in the "correct" place for me, lol. But I chose to wear them further down on my waistline, which gave me a looser look and fit. Overall, these are a nice addition to my collection of elevated sleepwear. ALICIA APPROVED!

review.title: Very Comfy And Soft Bamboo PJs 🌱🌿🌱
review.content: I ordered the Purple and the Pink in XL, and they fit better today than when I received them because I've lost some weight. Usually I order a size XXL because I'm 5'6", about 190 lbs, and have a bust size of 44F. I'm able to button the top without gaps now, and the overall fit is looser. The bamboo fabric is soft, silky smooth, and lightweight. It's very breathable, and perfect for hot sleepers or menopause. The button up shirt and shorts are really cute. The Purple is more of a Heather Purple, not a single color Purple. I like the Heathering though. It's very pretty. The Pink is a solid Pink without Heathering. Both PJ Sets are well-made and of high-quality. I would say to order your usual size because the size chart measurements seem accurate. These PJs are extremely wearable and easy to sleep in and to lounge around. Even though the fabric is lightweight, it's heavy enough not to be clingy or see-through. All-in-all a very nice PJ set. 💤🌟💤 Sweet Dreams 💤🌟💤

review.title: Soft, but everything fits comfortably except the waistband
review.content: I was worried about the sizing and I guess rightfully so. The listed measurements sounded like the top would fit me very comfortably but that the waist might be a bit small on me. I was hoping the elastic would be super forgiving and the measurements were taken without it stretched out. I have a 44" bust, 41.5" natural waist, and 50" hips. The shorts are totally fine in the hips, plenty of room to move around, but the elastic waistband is giving me an uncomfortably tight/long hug. It will stretch far larger but I don't like any restrictive feelings in the clothing I wear, especially when it's supposed to be loungewear. I'm not sure why I keep encountering bottoms where the measurements indicate they'll fit my admittedly wide hips with no issue but they're going to squish my midsection relentlessly. I'm not sure what kind of proportions whoever is cutting these expects humans to have but I ain't it, I guess. I do like the heathered lavender color and the material is very soft against my skin. It would be super comfy if my waist wasn't quite so large, but it's sort of an unfortunate situation as it stands.

product.product_name: Women Bamboo Viscose Pajama Sets Ruffled Cuff Hem Long Sleeve Fancy Yarn 2 Piece Loungewear Loose Fit Drop Shoulder (Pink)

review.title: Fingers crossed they keep me cool and comfy while I sleep!
review.content: So, as a woman of a certain age, I tend to run warm most of the time - especially at night. To the point that my preferred nightwear is my birthday suit (IYKYK). That said, I have an 11-day girls’ only trip coming up in July - and my roommates are unlikely to have the same level of appreciation for my (lack of) sleeping attire as my husband. 🤣 I have a bamboo cooling blanket that has made such a difference that I literally bring it with me when I travel; given how well it regulates my temperature I decided to give these cute little jammies a try. Although black’s not usually my first choice I decided it would be the most forgiving in this scenario; it’s unlikely to be see through and there’s far less chance of having any high-beam issues (light colors are more prone to casting shadows and/or being transparent). The fit and style seem to be a win:win; I’m on the fluffy side and well-endowed but the buttons don’t gap so I’m unlikely to flash anyone. I’ve only slept in them once and it was successful - the material doesn’t trap the heat and is slick enough so that I can roll around comfortable without getting caught up in the sheets. I’m giving 4 stars because the shorts are a bit snug around the waist compared to the roominess of the top. Looser elastic and a drawstring to make up the difference would be a great solution. Although I still prefer to sleep au naturel I’m happy with this product and feel comfortable recommending them to other post-menopausal hotties like myself. 🤗 Thank you for reading my review, I hope it was helpful.

The ruching design flattered her figure, providing a slimming effect that made her feel confident walking along the shore. She mentioned how the double-layer design offered great support and tummy control without feeling constricted. All in all, it was a great swimsuit for her, combining comfort and style effortlessly.

review.title: Not Quite The Perfect Fit
review.content: This fabric is extremely comfortable, making these a light, pajama that keeps you cool in warm weather. The lavender color is very pretty, and in certain lighting looks gray. The hems are generous, and well sewn. No loose threads, stitches are tight. I like the button up front, with lots of material. The armholes are wide, and there’s no constriction across the bust. The shorts are not as long as modeled, with the crotch being about 2 inches from the hem of the leg holes. When wearing the shorts, they either need to be pulled up to an uncomfortable height, or worn at the waist, but then the crotch area will be dropped very low. Adding side pockets would definitely have been a plus. While the top is a great design, and fits well, the shorts have some flaws that if corrected, would make this a great pajama set. I don’t think I would pay this price for a summer pajama set, especially when not that pleased with the fit of the shorts.

review.title: Soft, but everything fits comfortably except the waistband
review.content: I was worried about the sizing and I guess rightfully so. The listed measurements sounded like the top would fit me very comfortably but that the waist might be a bit small on me. I was hoping the elastic would be super forgiving and the measurements were taken without it stretched out. I have a 44" bust, 41.5" natural waist, and 50" hips. The shorts are totally fine in the hips, plenty of room to move around, but the elastic waistband is giving me an uncomfortably tight/long hug. It will stretch far larger but I don't like any restrictive feelings in the clothing I wear, especially when it's supposed to be loungewear. I'm not sure why I keep encountering bottoms where the measurements indicate they'll fit my admittedly wide hips with no issue but they're going to squish my midsection relentlessly. I'm not sure what kind of proportions whoever is cutting these expects humans to have but I ain't it, I guess.

review.title: Super beautifully designed swimsuit, comfortable too, and body flattering!
review.content: If I could give this swimsuit 10 stars I would! It is the cutest design in a swimsuit. I’ve seen in a long time! You could even wear this swimsuit with a sarong, or a skirt tight around the bottom or even pair it up with a pair of lousy pants because it would make a really cute top with these way the three ties in front come across your midriff. So happy with it and I would say don’t worry about the size just order what you think it’s pretty true to size I got a large and it fits great! The colors are really beautiful. Also, they’re very subtle and there’s these gold accents in the middle of the ties which I would hand wash it. I think to save them from getting ruined. review.title: Nice suit, flattering, reasonably priced.
review.content: I'm very pleased with this Lulukaka one piece swimsuit. The material is stretchy, thicker, not cheap looking, and the inside is fully lined. The entire suit is slimming, smoothing and holds you in nicely everywhere (not just the tummy) without being too tight or cutting in. There is ruching on the sides and a square neckline which I found both to be very flattering. The top area has adjustable straps and pads that I left in, even considering being a 40D. They actually minimize my boobs a bit which is a nice change for me! Note: if you were to remove the pads, you wouldn't be able to put them back in. The back is just the right amount of cheeky, looking sexy without exposing too much. The only negative is it did ride up a tad when walking although I think this could be corrected by losening the top straps a bit.

product.product_name: Bamboo Long-Sleeve Baby One-Piece Monster Truck

review.title: Too Big, Too Cold, But...Just Right?
review.content: First of all, they arrived with pink piping, not white as shown in the photos. That was really disappointing. Plus, I ordered an XL based on the size chart for the pants, knowing the top would probably be loose, but I figured that'd be okay for sleeping. I'm large-busted, so I often have to size up for that anyway. But these are way too big. I usually wear M/L (10/12) and the pants chart told me to get an XL (14/16). You can see in the pics they look pretty sloppy. For reference, I'm 5'5 &145-150 lbs. I wish I'd gotten the large. Or even the Medium. The one problem could be the waist if I'd gone too small. It was the one thing that actually fit right on the XL and that may be due to the drawstring. I wish I'd been aware of the adjustability of the pants when choosing the size. The last thing I disliked about these pajamas is that they feel cold when you first put them on. I hate, so much, when I'm already cold, to put on something even colder. The good news is, they warm up super quickly. And I suppose you could always put them on a heated towel rack, or in the dryer, or lay them close to a heat source if you're really a wuss (like I apparently am). Once they warmed up, though, they were nice and cozy.

review.content: This outfit is made of a heavier material that I can't see being great on a really hot summer day. I ordered my usual size, so maybe it would have been smart to order a size up, but it's too late for that now. I will be keeping them, because I want to lose some weight anyways, so I hope to get a better fit in them after a couple months. For now, I can still wear the top. I don't personally Recommend this outfit, as the price is a bit high for me, and the fabric is a bit heavy. That's just me personally, so I still gave it 4 stars for being very well made. They really feel like quality clothing, which is a sign that they will last a long time through washes, making it a good choice for our Planet! For that reason, I say it's worth a try to see if you like this fabric mix (84% Polyamide, 16% Elastane).

Combined with the shorts and cropped sleeves, it's great for getting your little one through the hotter months without sweltering. The two-way zipper is fantastic for easy diaper changes without all the fuss of having to remove their whole outfit. The material is also very stretchy, so it's not at all hard to get your baby's legs and arms in and out of the outfit, even if they're squirmy.

product.product_name: Bamboo Long-Sleeve Baby One-Piece (Watercolor Rose)

review.title: Superior Quality- 10 Stars!
review.content: I ordered a XL and the sizing description is 100% accurate and I generally upsize a little. This fit as I was expecting it to fit based on size description. The color pictured does not do this 2 piece outfit justice as it is prettier than pictured. This could be worn to the gym or out shopping or just around the house for the weekend or a family/friend gathering such and a BBQ. What I find most impressive is the quality of the material. The material is so much better than I even imagined and it feels heavy but not heavy in a bad way it is just very good quality material. As far as our waiting on the material I would give this 10 stars if I could. I can honestly say that I never see this kind of quality anywhere anymore. It’s a very good material and even though it’s heavy it’s very airy so I do not think it’s going to be something that’s going to be hot and sweaty it is a breathable material. My daughter loved it and asked where I got it and to send her the link because she would like to get one for herself because she said this would be the perfect for her to throw on to run errands or go to the park with her toddler. If you’re looking for something to wear as I described above and you want something that’s really good quality, that’s going to last a long time then this is it! I have not washed it yet but I don’t anticipate any problems. I also live in a very hot climate and although the material is good quality and thick because it is airy I do not think that this is going to be overly hot at all I think it’s going to allow my skin room to breathe. Not sure if I mentioned that it is also very comfortable. I plan on washing it and wearing it right away. I’m really excited about this outfit and it’s so soft and comfortable. At first I was afraid it was going to feel hot but once I tried it on I could actually feel how breathable the material is.

review.title: Cute style, silky soft fabric feels luxurious, but sizing is off
review.content: I ordered this Bamboo Rayon Pajama Set in XL, which is larger than normal for me… I usually order a large, but when I read the waist size, I ordered the larger size, and even so, the waist was snug. The fit on me looks like it does on the model, with the extra looooong sleeves and drop shoulders. It looks OK, as a cute, oversized look that will be comfortable for sleep. However, since this was an XL, the waist should have been looser on me. The sizing seems off. I wish the waist was looser like a size XL should be on me… in most brands of pajamas, an XL would be too big all over including the waist, so the inaccurate sizing is my one complaint. Well, the sleeves are unnecessarily long too, so if the waist wasn’t inordinately tight, I wouldn’t complain about the sleeve length. This sizing glitch is too bad, as the pajamas are lovely. The silky soft fabric feels luxurious, and the ruffle trim gives the pajamas a cute feminine look. If someone unexpectedly showed up and I was wearing these pajamas, I would feel OK dressed for a visitor… rather than needing to do a quick change. Oh, one other point… I probably wouldn’t take these pajamas on a trip or flight where the weight of luggage matters... because the overall pajama set weight is surprisingly HEAVY… nothing to do with the breathability of the fabric but the package weight upon arrival was heavy for a pajama set. But their weight also adds to the perception of quality, and this set is indeed a quality set of pajamas.

review.title: Loungewear
review.content: This loungewear set is not only perfect for hanging around the house but you can wear it to go exercise or run errands too! I think it would more appropriately be called “athleisure” because you can wear it for lots of reasons. Both the top and shorts are plain without embellishments, which makes it nice for multipurpose use. They do not look like pajamas. I love that i can slip this outfit on after work or on the weekend to be at home, yet feel equally comfortable going for a walk in the neighborhood in it. The outfit is made of a really nice cotton blend material with a hint of stretch to it. The top is loose and the shorts have an elastic waistband. Both fit me very well. The outfit washed nicely and did not fade or shrink at all. This set is a great addition to my wardrobe!

review.title: Comfy, feels like workout gear
review.content: I ordered this set just to have something to lounge around in during the summer time and at first I was hoping for something like a flowy cotton. But upon opening the package I realized that it’s more like workout gear material—which isn’t necessarily a bad thing, especially in the heat! I usually wear medium in clothing but I ordered the large for a more oversized feel and it fits exactly how I hoped it would! If you want it to be more form fitting, order your normal size. I would love for them to make another set just like this but in cotton!

product.product_name: Women's Chocolate Brown Polyester Lounge Set | Oversized Short Sleeve Top & Shorts

review.title: Florals for Spring? Actually Groundbreaking.
review.content: I bought this Floral Ruffle One-Piece half-expecting to look like a garden shed, but the appearance is surprisingly chic and vintage-inspired. The ruffle sleeves are the real MVPs here—they add a soft, feminine touch and stay put even when I’m doing my best "graceful swan" impression in the pool. For a one-piece, the coverage is spot-on; it’s modest enough that I’m not constantly checking for wardrobe malfunctions, yet that front cutout gives it a modern edge so I don't feel like I'm wearing a Victorian diving bell. The quality of the fabric is substantial and thick, providing that "held-in" feeling thanks to the tummy control power mesh, while the stretchiness ensures I can actually breathe and eat a taco without regret. It’s a comfortable, flattering fit that doesn't dig in at the hips or shoulders, making it my new go-to for looking like a functional adult at the beach. 5 stars for a suit that survives the waves and the snack bar with equal grace.

review.title: itchy boobs but cute
review.content: It covers my butt! I'm not one for bikini bottoms that feel like they give me wedgies all of the time. It's itchy where the breasts are, which is why I gave this 3 stars. Other than that, it is comfortable on the body, covers my butt well and even has removable breast cups. I don't know if the bunching of the fabric around my tummy area actually makes my stomach look any smaller. I wear a size medium on top and a size extra large on the bottom and large fit me just fine. I followed their sizing guide and it is accurate! This is one of those few cases where I'm actually really happy that the color on the model is different than what I ordered. It is not a lime green but more of a forest or a warmer, darker toned green. I'm not sure about the material quality, only because they decided to use mesh around the breasts and that's uncomfortable and itchy. If you have sensory issues, skip this one. For everyone else who doesn't mind a little bit of a texture on your breasts, and can habituate to it, then it's not a problem. It's got nice stitching. Happy to say that the straps came on perfect and fit me well. It doesn't fit me the way I had hoped, but that's more on my body shape than the design itself. I do hate that the neckline top of the swimsuit doesn't lay flat and looks messy. I tried fixing it but it stays the same.

review.title: Slightly large, but heckin’ soft and breathable!
review.content: The first thing I noticed about this material when slipping it on was that it was SO SOFT AND LIGHTWEIGHT. The material feels truly well-made, and worth its cost considering the softness and overall quality (no loose buttons, or frayed hems). To me, it’s a great balance of soft and airy, which I need as I can get extremely hot at night. Despite feeling lighter than a feather, this sleepwear has a subtle weight to it that makes it feel very quality when you touch it. The colors are true to the advertisement, and are a lovely shade of soft pink (I have purple accent lights so my photo color is not exact but the set does match the ad!)✨ I will say that these seem a little large in size. I’m not mad about it, because for me sleepwear needs a bit of extra wiggle room. It’s loose and comfy without feeling ”droopy” and is just right for maximum relaxation and maybe a little pre-bedtime snack indulgence or lazing around on the weekends. Overall, I’d say these jammies are a quality set that is well worth its current cost. Considering the incredible softness, the luxurious feel, and the breathability at night, I genuinely believe it’s worth picking up. Treat yourself, queen~ PS: It has a pocket, which will always get an honorable mention!

review.title: Bamboo and Rayon Pajamas
review.content: I ordered these pajamas because I get hot when sleeping and I've had a lot of luck with things made with bamboo helping to keep me from getting too hot. For that, these worked great. I am not a big fan of the fit of these and I absolutely hate the ruffles, especially the ones at the bottom of the legs. They flop around everywhere when I'm walking and even get caught on things. The ones on the wrists are very distracting to me whenever I use my hands, and if I happen to scratch my face when sleeping, they surprise me because the ruffles falls all over my face. I hate these ruffles so much that I have considered cutting them off because other than that, I think the pajamas are fine. I machine washed and dried these before wearing them and I did find a few loose threads when I checked them over. I did not see any holes or other areas of damage, so they may have just been left over from the manufacturing. I think these are a little expensive and for the amount of money they cost, I think the design could be better. But, if you think you would like the ruffles, you're going to love these.

review.title: Beautiful suit made with high quality, super soft fabric!
review.content: This one piece bathing suit is not the typical suit I would purchase but I thought I’d give it a try because I can always return it if I don’t like it! That’s the best thing about Amazon!! I tried it on and was totally surprised! I have never looked good in ANYTHING GREEN!! But this looks great on me! And my husband VERY RARELY says anything about my clothes when he sees me in anything new. When he saw me in this, he looked totally surprised and said he really loved it!! (Green is one of his favorite colors!) I also thought I wouldn’t like the big button things on the front but I don’t even notice them at all!! And the FABRIC?!!! It is SO INCREDIBLY SOFT!! And it was only $35!!! Where can you get a beautiful, super soft bathing suit for under $50?!!! The only thing I’m not thrilled with is that it does go up my behind!! Not so much that I won’t wear it, but I do need to pull at it every once in awhile!! It’s not a total wedgy! And it’s not a deal breaker either! I got a medium size and I’m about 5’2” and I weigh about 129lbs. But my belly is not flat!! I think the last time I measured around my belly, it was about 33”!! But my waist was about 29” and I think the suit fit just right. Maybe a large would fit even better, but I think I’m happy with the one I got! It is definitely worth the price! I think you’ll be very happy with this suit!! One more thing, when I first saw this bathing suit, I didn’t think it was “ME” because I don’t usually wear anything “flashy” that has anything on it like this suit does, but after I got it and tried it on, I was so surprised by how well it looked and felt!! I just can’t tell you how happy I am with this bathing suit!

product.product_name: Plain Women's Short-Sleeve Long Pajama Set

review.title: Breathable, Comfy, and Cute!
review.content: This is incredibly soft, feels smooth on the skin, comfortable, stylish, and so breathable! It feels almost polyester-y because of how smooth it is but PJs made of polyester make me overheat and I was chilling (literally) in these. These are so cozy and comfortable! I love that the black is a proper black and the white piping detail paired with the cute black pearlescent buttons truly elevates the look. Just note that the buttons are more of a pearlescent/shiny grey not white. There are no pockets on the shorts but the top left of the shirt does have a small pocket. Also, these fit comfortably and are true to size, but the waistband could be slightly looser (and I have a smaller waist, so this is not usually something I note!). As such, if you want a more comfy fit, maybe consider sizing up.

review.title: Bamboo for comfort and for the environment!
review.content: Anything made from bamboo wins in my book! And this pajama set does not disappoint. Just as the Lulukaka tag states, it truly is buttery soft, yet it also feels like it will be cool in Summer and warm in the Winter. The medium size fit very well on my medium build, 5'4" frame, with pilots of room and stretch. My measurements right now are 37"x32"x40" and 150 lbs. The bottoms are snug at the waist since I dont have a small waist, putting the elastic right at my belly button. There is plenty of room in the hips for a more hour glass or pear shaped figure. The space between the buttons doesn't have gapping if I'm standing upright. These buttons have an abalone shell look to them which compliments the black color and adds to the classy style of the white piping. I totally recommend these pj's!

review.title: Wonderful Swimsuit
review.content: This suit is adorable!! The fit is true to size, so don’t worry about that. However, the straps do not adjust so what it is is what it is. This means that if one has a long torso or a larger bust, this may be tight on the shoulders. For me, a 5’6”, B-cup, 125# average female, it fits well. There is full coverage in the bottom end, and good tummy control. The fabric is of good quality so should through the season, if not for two. The elastic seems strong enough to last, though chlorine and salt could factor in. So far, no fading. Hand wash, hang dry. Highly recommended.

The adjustable shoulder straps are a generous 12 inches long, and the removeable bra cups provide a little added shaping if desired or a more natural shape without them. The 2 ½" side panel on either side along with the ruching hide the fact that there's a nice bit of tummy control built in. I love everything about this swimsuit except that, at 5'8" and 160 lbs wearing a large, it rides a little high over my butt cheeks. This swimsuit is definitely worth the price.

review.title: Amazingly Comfortable Lounge Set
review.content: So comfortable! The lulukaka Lounge Set is like a cloud against your skin. The material is truly butter-soft and has a cool hand to it. The shirt is oversized as styled, and the biker shorts are more fitted, but they are not too tight to feel like compression shorts. I am 5'4" and 128 pounds, and the shirt is very roomy on me, and the shorts fit, but are not constraining in any way. While lounging in this set, I appreciated the oversized shirt to allow for unlimited range of motion and movement. There are no pockets on the shorts. The color is very rich and saturated and looks beautiful and brand new after several laundry cycles. The set washes and dries beautifully with absolutely no wrinkles. The set is extremely comfortable and is a great value for the money.

review.title: Old Hollywood Elegance in a Modern One-Piece
review.content: This swimsuit channels serious vintage glam - from the structured square neckline to the subtle side ruching, it’s the kind of suit that makes you feel instantly put-together and a little bit iconic. review.title: Well made; cool; comfortable; true to size for a relaxed fit; wash cold/dry low heat
review.content: This is a fantastic set of bamboo pajamas. I ordered them for my daughter. The upstairs level of our home can get fairly hot in the summer even with central a/c. And I thought these might keep her more comfortable. She has found them to be very cool and comfortable. They seem to run true to size and are a relaxed fit. They are very well made and quite adorable. She really likes them. We have followed the laundering guidelines because we've discovered that where bamboo is concerned, that can be very important. So we wash them on cold and dry them on low heat. If you plan to do otherwise, you'll want to consider ordering a larger size because they will most likely shrink.

product.product_name: Bamboo Viscose Toddler & Kids Pajama Set 12M-7Y, Fisherman Print Long Sleeve

review.title: Comfortable fit. Soft fabric.
review.content: I ordered these pajamas in the xl (size 16-18) and they fit me well. I have a 38.5” waist, 44.5” hips, and bust is 42.5”. These are meant to be loose and they are on me-nothing snug or restrictive. There is plenty of elastic in the waist if you should need to size up or down a bit. The elastic waistband is comfortable and does not dig in to my waist. Material is very soft and silky. It also has some nice drape to it. It’s still a bit too chilly for these to be worn but I can’t wait to see how well they cool in the hot summer months. When I tried them on in my chilly house I could definitely feel a cooling effect to them. The lavender color is a nice shade as well. My Amazon rating system- Five stars-As described. May have a minor problem. Good to great value. Four stars-As described but may have a more noticeable flaw or problem. Or, not as good as value. Three stars-Good item. Has a flaw/problem that requires more work than should be invested in a product. Two stars-May be a good item with work. Or, doesn’t work for me but may for someone else. One star-Nope. Doesn’t work for me and probably won’t for anyone else.

review.title: Ann Amazon Shopper
review.content: The swim suit is nicely lined. There is a lot of excess fabric throughout the torso area which would be problematic once in the water. The design definitely does not have a high cut leg but instead leans towards those decades wheee one piece swimsuits hit women where their legs were widest, so this will be a tough look to wear for many women present day. The straps in the back are adjustable which could be helpful. The swimsuit didn’t work for me and my 5’8” height with more of my height in my legs vs my torso. I weigh 150-155 lbs, but this swimsuit did not fit me well or flatter. The print is cute and the fabric lining the swimsuit is purple. There is nothing see through about the swimsuit at all.

review.title: Quite Comfortable PJs, but Size Up if You're Curvy!
review.content: I'm always on the lookout for soft but COOL pajamas for our warm weather here in Florida. I also prefer shorts, as it can get windy and I don't need my neighbors seeing all that if a gust goes right up main street after I've waved and am picking up my paper on the weekend. When these arrived, I immediately needed to wash them. They had a chemically, plastic-y smell to them right out of the package. They were very soft, though, and I honestly was a bit worried the smell had to do with the softness and thought they'd be rough after the wash like some imported clothing can unfortunately be. Luckily, that is not the case with these! After they came out of the dryer, it was time to try them out. The cut of the top is a bit boxer than many women's tops, and may pose an issue with gaps and popping buttons to those a bit bigger-chested. Luckily I ordered this bigger than my normal size, so it isn't horrible as long as I'm not too active in them. The shorts are similarly cut, so I'd definitely recommend sizing up if you're curvy. Luckily, the waist is "small" for any XL, so these fit me ok in the waist and had enough room in the thigh and seat areas to still fit comfortably. Overall, I'm very happy with these lightweight, soft PJs and may get some more pairs in the other available colors.

review.content: Bamboo Rayon Pajama Sets XL 16~18 US Size Short Sleeve Drop Shoulder Size Loose Fit for Women Button Down Sleepwear Soft, Breathable Nightwear, Daily Loungewear Pink. Oh, man. I simply love bamboo pajamas. Really, anything made with bamboo is right for me. I discovered materials made from Bamboo almost 20 years ago living in Florida. I've been on the hunt for anything and everything made from Bamboo ever since. Why? Lemme tell you. Because it's not heavy. Not constricting. Doesn't shrink. Doesn't wrinkle. Seems to last forever. It's super cool, to the touch and on your body. It helps regulate body temperature. It's insanely moisture wicking....say it again. It's moisture wicking. What an amazing trait for a material to have. I have only one concern for these pajamas. NO POCKETS. Com'on! In my world, perfect pajamas are made from Bamboo and they have pockets. So these are not quite perfect. But they are darn close. Definitely recommended and would consider buying again.

product.product_name: Bamboo Viscose Toddler & Kids Pajama Set 12M-7Y, Fisherman Print Long Sleeve

review.title: Cutest pajamas I own
review.content: I adore this set of pajamas. Something about being a stay at home mom of two, who’s recently entered my 30’s has made me want to start investing in a bunch of cute matching pj sets (probably to help counter the fact that I’m stuck in my house for days at a time typically wearing the same depressing gray on gray sweats for multiple days in a row) and this set is my favorite purchase by far. It looks beautiful, the ruffles on the sleeves and pant legs make this set look so fancy. It looks exactly as it’s shown in the pictures. I ordered it in the light pink color and the color I received is an exact match of the color shown in the listing. I’m also a sucker for bamboo fabric, and seeing as this set is 95% viscose from bamboo and 5% spandex, means that it’s soft, lightweight, stretchy, cool, thin, and not clingy at all. It’s like the opposite of polyester, it’s breathable, doesn’t pill easily, and feels amazing on your skin. This set definitely fits true to size, I’m 5’3 145 lbs and I ordered a size large (I like my pajamas loose) and it fits me oversized, if you like your pjs to fit you a little bit more like the way they fit the model, and you’re my size, I would recommend getting a medium, basically just order the size you get in all of your other pajamas. The length on the pants is a little bit long for me but I have short legs and as long as I roll the waist up twice, then the length fits great. These are easy to wash, I threw them in a normal wash cycle with other light and white clothes and then threw them in the dryer on a regular cycle and they came out completely unharmed, no shrinkage, no pilling, no fading, and no different than when they went in. I really recommend this set if you want something to make you feel cute while your hangin at home, my husband actually compliments me every time I wear them. I think the price is great and the quality is as well.

review.title: Good pajamas
review.content: I have twins and so I'm always trying to find a good balance between budget and quality. I also try to buy pajamas that will fit both of them so I dont have to rummage through their pajamas to differentiate between the two. They are close to the same size but not exactly. These pajamas are great for my twins. They feel just like the premium brands out there but for about 2/3 the cost. They stretch nicely to fit my babies and my babies seem to be comfortable in them. They have a two way zipper which is a lifesaver. My twins are 2 now so I don't have to typically change their diapers at night but when I start smelling something as I'm getting the other ready for bed, it's easy for me to check if the stinky one needs a change. I'd recommend these pajamas to anyone with a baby looking for a little bit of luxury yet functionality in their pajamas

review.title: Cute & Comfortable One Piece
review.content: I'm a fan of this suit! I ordered a handful this summer and this one made one of the best impressions on me. I find this suit to be pretty mom friendly - the chest provides higher coverage and the square neckline is flattering - not many of my other one pieces are square neck. The "floral" print feels very cute and trendy and the stomach ruching is flattering without being too restrictive. The bottoms are medium coverage. I can be between a L and XL (5'4; 190lbs; curvy) and I ordered a L due to availability. While it works and I've already worn in once with a coverup over top, I think I would be more comfortable in an XL as it digs in. So I would say TTS for your typical bathing suit size but if in between and curvy size up.

review.title: Incredibly Comfortable and Cute
review.content: This is a wonderful two piece set! The fabric is incredibly soft and comfortable. The shirt is quiet heavy weight, but feels light once it is on. The shorts are comfortable around the waist and legs. I am really a 2X but this fits, although I wouldn't wear it out until I lose a little weight. So having said that if you are true XL this will be a great fit. (I assume all the sizes are true to size with a pinch of extra room like the XL). The lilac is a light and pretty shade, true to the screen color. I think this outfit will be perfect for summer, but also spring and fall when the temps are mild. This would easily work for jammies, lounge wear, running errands, and I suspect exercise because the fabric feels so comfortable and good. If I could give this more than five stars I really would.

review.content: These are lightweight ,kind of jersey feeling pajamas. The fabric is this but very comfortable. It has a tight weave to it,so I can see it also being warm in winter. I havent worn pajamas in years and still have several.of my expensive nightgowns, but I just dont wear tbem..i have almost grown kids,pets,rlderly family members that need help in the middle of the night. I wanted something that i could get up and run out the front door if needed, these are that thing. I keep a bug out bag in my truck in case I need to get someone to the hospital. product.product_name: Women's Chocolate Brown Polyester Lounge Set | Oversized Short Sleeve Top & Shorts

review.title: You can feel the quality:
review.content: This is an amazing pajama set! The bamboo, even mixed with rayon, is still SO soft! This fabric is very lightweight, it is cooling, it is fresh, and even for someone like me who lives where it's always hot, this set will be comfortable wearing on most days. The elastic band on the shorts is exactly what you want in pajamas shorts, it is stretchy and will hold on to you, but at the same time it is so soft and will not dig painfully into the skin. I have another pj set of shirt and pants, but with those I have to take off the pants when I am actually going to sleep, because they are just so tight on the belly. And it is not that they are small on me, because they are actually baggie, it's the elastic. Well that is not a problem with this set! These pajamas are not meant to be super sexy, but they are still quite cute, and you could even style them by tucking the shirt half or all the way, or by pulling the shirt a little off the shoulders. This is a very good set to have, and I think they could even become a favorite.

One it sucked in my tummy extra and gave me a nice silhouette. There are some pads on top so it maintains a nice shape on the bust part. I am 5'3" and 155 lbs and a medium fit me nicely. There were straps so you can adjust the top part if you wanted it higher or lower. Everything was sewn beautifully and the material is double layered so its nice and thick. LOVE this bathing suit. A classic look!

review.title: Great pajamas despite minor flaws
review.content: I own another set of medium-sized pajamas from this brand in a near-identical style and the waistband on this set (size Large) is tighter than the waistband on the Medium. Despite these issues, the pajamas are still tightly stitched and well-constructed but maintain enough stretch to be comfortable to sleep in. review.title: Makes My Flabby Tummy Look Flatter
review.content: So far I'm very happy with this swim suit. It came in a nice little zip lock bag. It has removable padding in the bra area. A nice touch if you're small chested like me. The suggested size was a medium if you wear 4-6. I'm a size 6 and usually fit into a size small. Size 0-2 should really be extra small and 4-6 should be small. 8-10 should be medium. Don't love the fact that their sizing makes people bigger than they really are so I deducted a star for that. Kinda feels like body shaming. However the suit did fit well. I didn't even need to adjust the straps. They were perfect right out of the package. The rouching helped make my tummy look flatter. I was concerned that there wouldn't be enough coverage for my butt as based on the reviews and a photo of one of the models however my butt is flat, hardly any curve so luckily for me it was enough coverage. But if you have a large booty this swimsuit may not cover it all. Overall it's comfortable and the flower design is really pretty. I haven't gone swimming in it yet or laid out in the sun so I can't say how it hold up to being in the sun or the pool or ocean but it feels like regular swimsuit material so I can't imagine that would be a problem. There was a little bit of extra material at the top which kinda made a crease. I'm not sure if it's supposed to be that way or not. Not a huge deal though. I like this swimsuit and do recommend it. Just remember if you're normally a size 4-6 get a medium not a small.

review.title: beautiful color, soft as a dream
review.content: These PJs are the most lovely color of pink!! Being made from bamboo (which is why they attracted my attention in the first place), I knew they would be soft. These PJs are beyond soft. They are as soft as a dream of floating lightly through the sun-drenched clouds!! Perhaps because of the weight of material, perhaps because of their light color, I find these to be a bit thinner than I would like. There are a very limited number of people who see me in my pajamas, so this is only a small concern. However, my nipples show through the light colored, light-weight material, which may be a bit more than I want my 13 year old son to see. If I had chosen a darker color, this would likely not be an issue. Are these delightful pajamas to wear in the summer when I get hot at night? YES! Are they comfortable to wear? YES! Would they be the best choice for a teenage girl to wear to a sleepover? not so much.

product.product_name: Christmas Family Matching Soft Reindeer Family Print PJS

review.title: Awesome PJ set! The fabric is SUBLIME, like a CLOUD!!!
review.content: Cute and super comfy! I love this PJ set. I really, really appreciate the amazing quality of the fabric these are made out of, first off. The fabric is so soft it feels like wearing a silky Angora rabbit fur knit shorts and top, but it never makes you feel overheated. It's like being wrapped in a cloud. So lightweight and breathable. I sleep hot so I absolutely LOVE this material. It's the softest most perfect lounge or pajama material I've ever felt. It's made out of rayon from bamboo with a tiny little bit of spandex added for stretch. Fit: I'm 5'4" tall and weigh approximately 176 lbs. My measurements are: 38D bust, 16.9" shoulders (when measured across my back), 36" waist and 48" hips. I got this PJ set in the XL 16-18 size and it is big on me, but I like my pajamas to be oversized just because they are comfier that way IMO. These do run big, though. If you usually wear a medium or small, be sure to check the chart first before ordering because they are larger than your typical small or medium would usually be (in US sizing at least). The sizing chart is accurate, so be sure to consult it. The medium size would've fit my measurements if I wanted them in a more tailored fit. These PJs work great in all seasons. I always feel comfortable in them temperature-wise. I never wake up sweaty or feel overheated under my blankets, and I never feel too cold, either. Like many other natural fibers, these PJs natural bamboo fabric has innate thermo-regulating properties, which means it naturally balances heat generation and heat loss. It draws heat away from you in hot weather and provides long-lasting warmth protection in cold weather to maintain the equilibrium of your body temp. Although I still can't wait to get the version of this PJ set with the pants too for winter! My mom has been getting hot flashes as she begins menopause and I got her a pair of these pajamas and she says she wishes she could live in them 24/7! I got these in the purple color and it is a bit darker than shown in the ad pics. It is not a light pastel lilac color, it's more of a slightly duller cool-toned lavender. Still very pretty, though. It is heathered too which gives it a cool finish. The shorts have a drawstring closure and they even have pockets! One on each hip.

review.content: I got this item for my beloved to wear, and she is very satisfied with it. We ordered a large instead of her size (medium), as we had read the reviews about the sizing running small, and this was absolutely necessary. We found that the outfit looked great. She says that the material feels breathable, comfortable, and nice on her skin. The only caveat I will give is that even though we got a size up, she still found the arms to be a bit short when extended. Because we got the large, it is clear that this is not a sizing issue, but rather a fit issue. Overall, though the product still deserves a five-star rating in my eyes.

review.title: Perfect pajamas
review.content: Absolutely love these!!! They are SO soft and comfortable, they wash perfectly, no fading or shrinking, and they're beautiful on. Very flattering and the top is long enough, which I almost always have a problem with, with pajama sets. I am 5' 10" and have a long torso but on top of that I feel like the trend is for almost cropped tops on everything. I love that this top isn't always riding up on me. I also love the ruffled edges- they somehow feel soft and cosy to me, since I only wear pajamas for sleep or truly lounging, they don't get in the way of doing anything. I can see that they might if you're wearing them while, say, cleaning the house. Absolutely recommend.

She's approximately 5'4" and weighs around 125 lbs. and they fit her perfectly. The fabric is a polyester spandex blend which made them feel very soft and cozy. This type of material shouldn't shrink in the wash, and they appear to be durable enough to last several years of Christmas. What's great is that you can buy a set for the whole family, including toddlers. Each outfit is around $25 a piece which I thought was a pretty good deal. The kids' prices are a little less expensive. Also, they have 3 different prints to choose from, so you can have your own family Merry Christmas!!

review.title: These are super cozy.
review.content: I love these from the moment I put the set on. But the top and the bottom are very lightweight. Synthetic material, but it's soft against your skin and not at all slick. The rose pattern on the pants is kind of retro, but it's very cute on, and the solid color top tempers the effect. I will say that these pajamas seem to run large. Order down if you're on the fence. I think they're a good value for the price, especially given the quality construction.
